title: ci: trim CI matrix, collapse redundant jobs, and bump GitHub Actions/test deps
author: Lena Schmidt
ci_status: pass (failed matrix job on first run due to flaky integration test, rerun succeeded)
release_notes: Reduce CI runtime by ~35% by collapsing redundant matrix entries, batch similar unit/test jobs, and bump GH Actions and test-related deps. No behavior changes to runtime; tooling-only.
description:
Summary: This PR reduces total CI runtime and maintenance surface by simplifying the GitHub Actions matrices, consolidating several nearly-identical jobs into grouped/parameterized steps, and updating a small set of Actions and test dependencies (actions/checkout, setup-go, node-version action, pytest and mocha dev deps).

Motivation: CI has been drifting toward long pipeline times because similar jobs were duplicated across multiple matrices (linux/python, linux/node, macos) and some jobs run end-to-end integration flows unnecessarily for lint-only changes. The infra team investigated and found typical pipeline wall-clock was ~42m; after these changes it's ~27m on average, with fewer queued runners and lower cost on self-hosted pools.

Changes included:
- Replace three per-OS, per-python-version matrices with a single cross-axis that only expands where tests actually vary (unit matrix now only varies python-version for packages that require it).
- Create a 'lint-and-fast-checks' composite step that runs once per push instead of per-matrix job.
- Collapse multiple unrelated e2e shims into a single parameterized job that accepts a 'profile' env var (smoke|full). Smoke runs by default; full runs are only triggered for nightly/release branches.
- Bump GH Actions versions: actions/checkout@v4 -> v4 (minor pinning), actions/setup-node pinned to v4.2.0, setup-go bumped to v4.3.1.
- Update test/dev deps where safe: pytest 7.x -> 7.3.x, pytest-cov bump, mocha 10.x -> 10.1.x; ran local test matrix to validate no behavioral regressions.
- Added repository-level caching for pip and npm artifacts using keyed caches to improve warm-run times.

Checklist:
- [x] Preserve test coverage and results for all affected jobs (unit, integration smoke, lint)
- [x] Verify PR builds on forks and main CI (self-hosted runners)
- [x] Document matrix changes in .github/ci/README.md
- [x] Run canary on release branch to ensure nightly full e2e still works

Motivation note: This is a toolchain/ops change only; no runtime code changes to the inference serving or API layers.

Commits (summary):
- refactor(ci): consolidate ci matrices and add composite lint step
- feat(ci): parameterized e2e job with smoke/full profiles
- chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node, setup-go, actions/cache keys
- chore(dev-deps): bump pytest/mocha minor versions and update lockfiles
- docs(ci): add CI README describing matrix decisions

Files touched (high-level):
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (matrix simplification, composite step references)
- .github/workflows/release.yml (ensure 'full' profile triggers on release)
- .github/workflows/nightly-e2e.yml (now uses parameterized job)
- .github/ci/README.md (new)
- scripts/ci/run_e2e.sh (parameterization and guard rails)
- tools/ci/cache-helpers.sh (cache key helpers)
- requirements-dev.txt, package.json (dev deps bumps)
- .github/actions/composite-lint/action.yml (new composite action wrapper)

Review conversation (high level):
- Evan Martinez: "Good reduction in job duplication. One request: make the lint composite opt-out for forks to avoid secrets leakage risk." -> Author reply: "Added skip-for-forks guard using github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork check; composite will run but skips steps that require secrets."
- Priya Nair: "Can we add a short README section explaining the 'smoke' vs 'full' triggers?" -> Author reply: "Done, added .github/ci/README.md with decision matrix and example triggers."
- Marco Rossi: "Observed a flaky integration that failed first CI run; was that caused by cache key change?" -> Author reply: "Tracked to a timing-dependent test (test_harness::wait_for_worker). I added a 50ms jitter in the smoke harness and marked the full integration to run on nightly; caches were rolled back for that job."

CI observations: First CI run failed one matrix entry (integration full) due to a flaky wait; reran single job and passed. Subsequent CI run on the PR passed all checks.

Performance: Measured median reduction ~35% wall-clock in CI, job-count reduced from 18 to 12 per push.

Rollout/Merge notes: Merged via squash to main after approvals from reviewers and green CI. No follow-up migrations required. If any repo in the monorepo experiences a new test failure that looks related, revert commit 3f7d9c2 (cache-key tweak) and open a follow-up to relax cache keying for that package.

Linear/Jira: ENG-4021 tracks the CI runtime reduction initiative; ENG-4039 tracks follow-ups to add more targeted cache keys and to roll the composite action into other repos.
